questions.text: What kind of motion is uniform rectilinear motion?
answers: Motion in which a body covers equal distances in equal time intervals and its trajectory is a straight line
Motion whose trajectory is a straight line
Any motion in which equal distances are covered in equal time intervals

questions.text: Which quantities of the velocity vector remain unchanged in uniform rectilinear motion?
answers: The magnitude increases uniformly, the direction does not change
Both the magnitude and the direction stay constant
Both the magnitude and the direction keep changing
The magnitude is constant while the direction changes continuously
